name: sit_ground_dazed
text: A dazed person is seated on the ground with bent knees and feet in front. They look down at their right knee, bend forward and rub the right shin and knee with both hands, then sit back up slowly with one hand touching the forehead. Stay seated on the ground throughout, clearly recovering from a fall.

review.reason: 坐地蜷腿、躯干前倾、手靠近腿部并有微动；保持段未整身冻住。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
